name: open-ga4-release-publisher
description: Pins the ClawHub publisher CLI for .github/workflows/release.yml, so the tool that holds CLAWHUB_TOKEN resolves from a committed, integrity-hashed lockfile instead of fresh semver ranges. Release tooling only: the open-ga4 skill installs, ships and loads nothing from here, and this manifest is not part of what a user gets. See the two publisher steps in .github/workflows/release.yml for why it exists, and src/release-workflow.test.ts for what is pinned about it.
